source_note: Inbox accounts@harbourline.co.uk, folder Suppliers / September 2026, exported 2026-09-30 08:05, twelve messages, oldest first. The export holds message bodies only. Attached PDFs are mentioned but not included, so every figure below comes from the message text. Mail that arrived after the export is not covered.
conventions: rec is the message number in the export (1 to 12); one record per message. A key that is absent means the message does not state it. inherited lists fields filled from the earlier record of the same invoice number because the message does not restate them. Money is a plain number in the record currency. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD. flags use the run legend and are observations, not decisions.
not_checked: Purchase orders, bank feed and supplier master were not read at this stage. So there are no POVAR, NOPO, PAID or REFUNDED flags, no PO variances, and no pay, hold or exclude decisions. No supplier was contacted and nothing in data/ was changed.
